calendarFaqs.q: When does school start in Lee County in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day for The School District of Lee County is Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Lee County Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Lee County Spring Break runs March 22–25, 2027. Good Friday follows on March 26, and March 29 is a professional duty day when students do not attend.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Lee County students return after Spring Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, March 30, 2027, after Spring Break, Good Friday, and the March 29 professional duty day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school in Lee County?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027, with early dismissal.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Lee County have a fall break?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Lee County 2026–27 instructional calendar does not list a separate fall break. Students have no school on the October 19 professional duty day.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the June 1–4 weather make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: Lee Schools reserves June 1–4, 2027 as severe weather make-up days. They may become school days if the district needs to recover time after closures.

calendarFaqs.q: Can I add the Lee County school calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Download the MySchoolDates .ics file for a one-time import into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. Check Lee Schools for later revisions.

rows: January 4 is a professional duty day. Students return from Winter Break on Tuesday, January 5.
Spring Break runs March 22–25. Good Friday is March 26 and March 29 is a professional duty day, so students return Tuesday, March 30.
Early dismissal is scheduled on all three dates, so families may need to adjust pickup or after-school care.
These dates are reserved for severe weather make-up and may become school days if closures have to be made up.
